predecessors.name: Malaysia
predecessors.text: Singapore: 'On 9 August 1965, the Malaysian Parliament voted 126 to 0 to pass a constitutional amendment bill, thereby separating Singapore from Malaysia'

ledger.x: 1965: Singapore becomes independent as the Republic of Singapore (9 August), 'with Lee Kuan Yew and Yusof bin Ishak as the first prime minister and president respectively'.

wars.name: Indonesia-Malaysia confrontation
wars.outcome: 'A final peace agreement was signed on 11 August 1966 with Indonesia formally recognising Malaysia'; the page records no territorial change.

certainty.note: A small island state whose frontier is its coast and the Johor Strait; the growth by reclamation (about 580 km2 in the 1960s to 770 km2 by the 2030s) is sharp but smaller than the grid's cell.

sources.title: Singapore in Malaysia (article titled 'State of Singapore (Malaysia)')
